evidence.text: The capital of Czechoslovakia is Prague.

George of Poděbrady died in the city of Prague.

The headquarters of Czech National Bank is located in the city of Prague.
Reinhard Heydrich died in the city of Prague.
The headquarters of Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty is located in the city of Prague.
Czech Radio was founded in the city of Prague.
Jan Palach died in the city of Prague.
Antonín Novotný died in the city of Prague.
